description: This file defines the Operations class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically focusing on logical operations such as AND, OR, XOR, and NOT. It implements Excel logical functions used for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: Class providing logical operation functions (AND, OR, XOR, NOT) for spreadsheet calculations, handling various input types and array evaluations.

methods.name: logicalAnd
methods.description: Returns TRUE if all arguments evaluate to TRUE; otherwise, FALSE. Implements the Excel AND function.

methods.name: logicalOr
methods.description: Returns TRUE if any argument evaluates to TRUE; otherwise, FALSE. Implements the Excel OR function.

methods.name: logicalXor
methods.description: Returns TRUE if an odd number of arguments evaluate to TRUE; otherwise, FALSE. Implements the Excel XOR function.

methods.name: NOT
methods.description: Returns the logical inverse of the provided argument, handling scalar and array inputs. Implements the Excel NOT function.
